issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: melon, pumpkin, red_wall_banner, cake.

visual.summary: Adds crates, a lamp post, a bush and flowers around it.
problems: The canopy is two full layers of solid blue and light-blue wool, bigger and heavier than the stall under it: from every view the stall is a bright blue box. Make the awning one block thick (or wool on the front edge and carpet/trapdoors behind), sloping down to the front
Colours: the saturated blue/cyan clashes with the medieval palette of every other structure. Use red and white like the butcher's awning, or brown/white, yellow/white
The counter and goods sit deep under the canopy and are half hidden; push the goods to the front edge so they show

visual.summary: Adds crates around it, a lamp post, a bush and flowers.
problems: Round 1 fixes are in: red and white stripes instead of neon blue, and the front awning is one layer stepping down from the back. Still a little heavy: the back canopy is wool on a full plank layer (two blocks thick); a single layer would look lighter. Not blocking.

notes.detail: Rich in props, but L3 is mostly more props (stool, back barrel, composter, flowers, leaves bush, banner); the lamp post with its sign at x0 z0 is the only thing near a new feature. Under Carlton's rule detail is at most 1 here.
notes.materials: Oak stairs stool (x4 z0) and oak leaves among the spruce are minor; fine.
notes.artefacts: Lantern on the fence post (x0 y2 z0) stands, hanging lanterns have wool above, banner hangs on the log at x4 z1; nothing floats.
notes.levels: Tells apart from L2 by the lamp post and the greenery, but no clear new job or structure part.

visual.summary: Level 3 adds a lamp post with a hanging sign, a red banner, a stool for customers, a back barrel, a scraps bin (composter) and bushes and flowers around the stall. It looks finished and lived-in, but the additions are props more than a new feature.
problems: L3 adds mostly props over L2: give it one clearly visible new part, e.g. a small side table or crate rack with goods on the open side (x6, z1-z3) or a short fence/rail making a customer area in front, so L3 has a feature of its own (detail capped at 1 until then).
